notice: Declared experimental noise levels for a synthetic 2D world, NOT measured D455/robot values. Randomness is injected only into physical quantities (B execution, per-frame detection, frame delivery); acquisition is still computed by geometry plus the storage gate. Replace with measured values when hardware logs exist.

shared.image_width_source: D455 nominal 1280-pixel stream width; focal length is derived from the scenario FOV, not from measured intrinsics
shared.object_width_source: declared tabletop object size for the experiment

none.description: Deterministic reference: must reproduce collect_designed.sample_pass exactly

medium.description: Default study level: indoor lighting, typical path-following error

high.description: Stress level: poor lighting, loose path following, lossy frames
